title: Settlement founding-fusion blend logic
scope: Qualitative founding-fusion blend logic and settlement founding frame for the hybrid ridge-spur hillfort settlement; parent-culture content, lifecycle rites, speech varieties, exchange media, in-world names, faith content, costume detail, compact terms, offices, succession provisions, demography, protagonist facts, and all natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'B — FOUNDING-FUSION' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option B exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set, and in the same review directed the founding frame: a founder native to the original culture, his admission of imperial refugees into the fold in the early founding days, unity and mutual respect between the inheritances under his leadership, early-stage ongoing hybridisation, and the original culture as the settlement's unsuppressed host culture with the imperial-descended as guests-turned-members.
question: Which qualitative blend logic governs how the ridge-spur hillfort settlement holds its two parent inheritances — the locally rooted original culture and the withdrawn power's imperial culture — through WLD-CULTURE-001's accepted strand-braid, and what founding frame stands behind that blend, without fixing either parent culture's content, any rite, speech variety, or exchange-medium fact, any in-world name, faith content, costume detail, compact term, office, or succession provision, any demographic proportion, or any protagonist fact?
selection: Use B — FOUNDING-FUSION, plus the proposal's shared claim set, plus the Author-directed founding frame. The settlement's founding-era disposition is remembered as fusion — inherited forms worked into settlement-specific composites — variously and disputably held, with no founding occasion, decision, deliberation, or event fixed; the charter-oath compact is remembered as the model case, an oath sworn in what residents call the original manner joined to witnessed, fallibly kept records in what they call the imperial manner. Standing accrues to households and persons seen to embody the joined way while purists of either inheritance keep real but narrower prestige, and the young composite identity is conscious and contested. The settlement virtue is the joined work and its shame is unravelling, each newly minted here or sharpened from a parent register and neither claimed as novel. Faith blends by syncretism as belief practice over the common occasions, with traditionalist forms kept in household privacy, and dress shows a recognisable settlement-specific composite. The Author-directed founding frame, established here as bounded claims: the settlement's founder was a native of the original culture — a declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question left open in WLD-CULTURE-002's founder-and-dynasty space, closing nothing else; in the early founding days he admitted imperial refugees into the fold to help build the settlement; under his leadership there has been unity and mutual respect between the inheritances; cultural hybridisation is early-stage and ongoing, not complete; and consequently the original culture is the settlement's unsuppressed host culture and the imperial-descended are guests-turned-members — present settlement relations only, altering nothing in WLD-HISTORY-001's account of the withdrawn power's historical regional administration.
alternatives: A — DOMAIN-SPLIT: the parent inheritances persist by domain, with imperial-attributed forms predominating in public administration, record keeping, walls-and-works, and defence and original-attributed forms in household, seasonal, land, and hospitality life; individuals switch practice-registers by domain, friction lives at the boundaries, faith blends by domain assignment, and dress reads by domain. The proposal's recommended option. Not selected.

B — FOUNDING-FUSION: a remembered founding-era disposition of fusion, inherited forms worked into settlement-specific composites with no founding occasion or event fixed; the compact remembered as the model case; standing for the joined way against narrower purist prestige; the virtue of the joined work and the shame of unravelling; syncretic observance over the common occasions; and a recognisable composite dress. Selected.

C — PRAGMATIC PATCHWORK: no settlement-wide blend logic, each household and strand braiding its own mix, deliberately thin procedural common institutions, a procedural keeping-terms status scale, plural coexisting observance with religious content kept off the common floor, and no settlement dress style. Not selected.
rationale: The selected blend deepens the accepted strand-braid with a remembered disposition rather than a narrated founding, gives the approaching first succession a live cultural argument about re-performance without resolving any designed ambiguity, and — with the Author-directed founding frame — grounds the settlement's present host-and-member relations in a native founder's admission of imperial refugees while keeping the hybridisation explicitly early-stage and unfinished.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-17: 'B — FOUNDING-FUSION' chosen from the displayed multiple-choice options, with the proposal's shared claim set and the Author-directed founding frame recorded in the same review.
consequences: The blend logic expresses through WLD-CULTURE-001's strand-braid, deepening the accepted fabric and replacing nothing; every strand's distinct household traditions persist untouched, unranked, and unflattened.

The founding-era disposition is remembered as fusion — inherited forms worked into settlement-specific composites — variously and disputably held, with no founding occasion, decision, deliberation, or event fixed.

Declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question left open in WLD-CULTURE-002's founder-and-dynasty space: the settlement's founder was a native of the original culture; the dynasty's later composition, every office-holder's origin, and every designed first-succession ambiguity class remain untouched and explicitly still open.

In the early founding days the founder admitted imperial refugees into the fold to help build the settlement; this is a standing founding-frame fact, not a narrated founding scene, and no occasion, count, proportion, date, or founder identity is established; the frame consumes WLD-HISTORY-001's disclaimed founding-composition space and extends WLD-LOCATION-001's declared-open founder space, which WLD-CULTURE-002 already fills in part, and neither record requires a boundary edit.

Under the founder's leadership there has been unity and mutual respect between the inheritances — a qualitative condition, not unanimity, not the absence of friction, and not a guarantee; WLD-CULTURE-001's accepted imperial-inheritance attitude spectrum stands unnarrowed.
Cultural hybridisation is early-stage and ongoing, not complete; no rate, stage count, endpoint, timetable, or completion is established.

The original culture is the settlement's host culture and the imperial-descended are guests-turned-members, with the original culture unsuppressed at the settlement — present settlement relations only, altering nothing in WLD-HISTORY-001's account of the withdrawn power's historical regional administration, and fixing no legal status, tenure, right, admission rule, or precedence order; WLD-CULTURE-002's hearth-based assembly standing is cited unchanged.

The compact is remembered as the model fusion case; the reading is resident belief and adds no compact term, office, text, procedure, or ambiguity resolution, and the succession ambiguities read as a re-performance question that sharpens the designed pressure and resolves nothing.

Standing accrues to households and persons seen to embody the joined way while purists of either inheritance keep real but narrower prestige inside their own circles; the young composite identity is conscious and contested.

The settlement virtue is the joined work and the settlement shame is unravelling, each newly minted here or sharpened and re-anchored from a parent register, neither claimed as novel against any parent frame.

Faith blends by syncretism as belief practice over non-lifecycle common occasions, with household-private traditionalist forms beneath the composite; no faith content, cosmology, afterlife idea, Soul claim, or metaphysical confirmation is established.
Dress shows a recognisable settlement-specific composite with marked parent dress for household and purist occasions; no garment, textile, material class, or costume detail is fixed.

Hillfort-side perception only: the settlement reads the outlet settlement as the unblended sibling and believes the outlet reads it as culturally mixed, with the standing rivalry colouring the perception as claims of standing; this decision establishes no outlet-side fact — an abstention of its own, denying nothing a sibling record establishes, and WLD-LOCATION-005's framing — 'primarily does not mean exclusively' — stands.
Generational texture is established as standing tension: anxious founders, confident walls-born, and a visible few reaching back past the fusion for purer parent forms as fashion or protest.
'Original-derived' and 'imperial-derived' remain fallible attributions mirroring WLD-LOCATION-004's discipline; a custom believed imperial may be original, and the reverse.
Parent-culture content, lifecycle rites, speech varieties, and exchange media remain wholly the batch siblings' territory, and the lifecycle occasions are neither assigned nor excluded here.

WLD-EVENT-001's rivalry is coloured as perception and argument material only, with no incident, negotiation, embargo occurrence, or trade fact created and no pressure class resolved; WLD-LOCATION-004's remnant avoidance stays practical, not ritual; and WLD-GEOGRAPHY-001, WLD-ECOLOGY-004, and WLD-ECOLOGY-006 are untouched, with the spring pulse's mortality-channel-only boundary and every harvest institution still open.

No new System mechanic, readout guarantee, System-executed institutional power, CAL0 change, or project-default adoption is created; the WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected read-only; no reincarnate or exceptional individual is named or implied; the parked sapient pack species and the returning peoples gain no development; and no protagonist fact is established.
Every open boundary of every touched record stays open except the single declared narrow closure of the founder-origin question.
residual_unknowns: What the parent inheritances actually contain, and how far the settlement's original-derived and imperial-derived attributions are historically wrong.
How the early-stage fusion proceeds — deepening, stalling, drifting, or reversing — and over what generations.
What the remembered founding disposition actually consisted of as against what occurred, and how the settlement's founding narrative is told, misremembered, and disputed.
The dynasty's later composition, the office-holders' origins, and the succession's contenders, all still open under WLD-CULTURE-002.
How the re-performance argument is actually argued and adjudicated within WLD-CULTURE-002's open procedure space.
All observance, foodway, costume, craft, and material-class content of the composites and of the surviving parent forms.
What faith contents and cosmologies the syncretic composites carry as belief, and which fallible institutional carriers hold them.
How host-and-member relations are expressed in ordinary settlement life, and whether any settlement virtue or shame acquires customary enforcement, and by whom.
How the outlet settlement actually reads specific hillfort practices, and its own internal cultural variety, left entirely open here.
The direction of generational reaching-back for purer parent forms — fashion, protest, or revival.
All in-world names, self-designations, and linguistic logic for the settlement, its inheritances, its composites, and its virtues.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted parent-frame, rites, language, or exchange work cannot be held as settlement-specific composites under a remembered fusion disposition.
Later accepted succession or governance work cannot be reconciled with a native founder who admitted imperial refugees into the fold, or requires the founder-origin closure to be reversed.
Later accepted work requires the hybridisation to be treated as complete or as absent rather than early-stage and ongoing.
Later accepted outlet-side work makes the hillfort's unblended-sibling perception unsupportable as perception.
The Author explicitly chooses another blend logic or another founding frame.
